title: 先说简单的话  (Simple Words First)

segments.t: Twenty minutes before noon, Hao paces across the courtyard stones clutching a crumpled sheet of notes while Qing walks over with a glass of cool water. Listen first.
志豪先生，喝口凉水吧。纸上写的什么？
五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
第二句：这三年我很想你。
这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
坐下吧——有热茶和星期五柠檬蛋糕。
热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
志豪先生，喝口凉水吧。纸上写的什么？
'Mr Zhihao, drink a sip of cool water. What is written on that paper?' Small mouthfuls of water or bites of cake use
口
literally 'mouth', giving 'drink a mouthful of cool water'.
十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
'Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?' Compound
时刻表
stacks 'hour-quarter-chart' to name a train or bus timetable.
我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
'Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!' Pairing 'one' before 'nervous' with 'then' before 'turn' builds 'the moment I get nervous, my lines turn long'.
快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
'Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.' Directional compound
折起来
combines 'fold' with 'up-together' for folding a sheet neatly away.
先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
'Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.' Spoken lines and sentences take
句
so Qing coaches him through 'first line, second line, third line'.
你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
'Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that line.' Slipping 'able' inside 'remember-hold' creates
记得住
meaning 'able to hold in memory'—'I can remember it'.
第二句：这三年我很想你。
'Second line: I missed you very much these three years.' Warm emotional use of
想
when followed by a person rather than an action, it shifts from 'want to' to 'miss someone'.
这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
'I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?' Praise word
真诚
joins 'true' with 'sincere' for words spoken straight from the heart. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
志豪先生，喝口凉水吧。纸上写的什么？
五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
第二句：这三年我很想你。
这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
坐下吧——有热茶和星期五柠檬蛋糕。
热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
No nineteen-point speech—just 'thank you for coming', 'I missed you', and 'sit down for hot tea and lemon cake'. Ten minutes left until noon. See you next time.
回头见！
